_comment: Single source of truth for model selection in run_prune4web.py. Edit this file to switch backends without touching code. Precedence: CLI flag > env var > this file > built-in default.

planner._note: Currently no fine-tuned local planner exists. To use a local OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM/Ollama/LM Studio), set backend='openai', model to the served name, and export OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:<port>/v1.

filter._note: 'local' = deterministic keyword extractor + DOM-Delta(MiniLM) hybrid, no API call. 'gpt4o' = legacy keyword-weight LLM via PRUNE4WEB_FILTER_MODEL.

embeddings._note: Used by DOM-Delta hybrid scorer. alpha_blend = weight on the keyword score; (1 - alpha_blend) goes to the MiniLM cosine score.

privacy._note: dp_epsilon=0 disables differential-privacy noise on numeric fields. Set to 1.0 or similar to enable.
